index.title: Introduction
index.description: Cobalto: editorial UI components for Tailwind CSS v4, with colors you change with a single variable.
index.metaTitle: Cobalto · UI components for Tailwind CSS
index.heading:
Editorial components
for *Tailwind CSS v4.*
index.lead: Components for Tailwind CSS v4 with monospaced typography, thin borders instead of shadows and a color system you change with a single variable.
index.noteAfter: to search for any component or class.

quick.title: In 30 seconds
quick.desc: Import Cobalto after Tailwind and use the `cb-*` classes in your HTML.

items.title: Tokens first
items.text: No component uses fixed colors. Everything goes through `--cb-*` variables.

items.title: Your utilities win
items.text: Components live in `@layer components`, so `mt-0` or `bg-cb-bg-2` always override them.

items.title: Optional JS
items.text: `data-cb-*` attributes, no dependencies, compatible with Livewire and Alpine.

instalacion.title: Installation
instalacion.description: How to install Cobalto with npm and Tailwind CSS v4, from a CDN with no build, or in Laravel with Vite and Livewire.
instalacion.keywords: npm cdn laravel vite livewire alpine blade font install texts messages language
instalacion.lead: Two ways to use it: as a source for your Tailwind CSS v4 build, or precompiled from a CDN. The package is published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cobalto).

tailwind.title: With Tailwind (recommended)
tailwind.desc: This way you can use the `bg-cb-bg`, `text-cb-muted` or `dark:` utilities in your own HTML and only the CSS you use is generated.
tailwind.js: And the JavaScript, if you use interactive components:
tailwind.auto: `autoInit()` restores the saved theme, initializes the page and watches the DOM to initialize anything added later. If you prefer manual control, call `cobalto.init(element)`. You can also import individual components:

cdn.title: No build, from a CDN
cdn.desc: The precompiled CSS includes the Tailwind reset, the tokens and all the components. The UMD script initializes itself; add `data-cb-manual` to prevent that.
cdn.note: With a CDN you don't get arbitrary Tailwind utilities, only the `cb-*` classes, `cb-wrap` and the utilities the components themselves use.

laravel.title: Laravel + Vite
laravel.desc: Laravel 12 and 13 already ship with Tailwind v4 and Vite. Nothing else needs to be configured.
laravel.css: Add Cobalto right after Tailwind, in the CSS that comes with the project:
laravel.flash: In the layout, add this script in the `head` to apply the saved theme before the first paint and avoid flicker. It is the same for any stack:

livewire.title: Livewire and Alpine
items: `autoInit()` listens for `livewire:navigated` and reinitializes after every `wire:navigate` (Livewire 3 and 4).
A `MutationObserver` initializes the components that Livewire or Alpine add to the DOM. Anything already initialized is not duplicated.
Cobalto only uses `data-cb-*` attributes and `cb-*` classes, so it doesn't clash with `x-*` or `wire:*`.
If Livewire re-renders an open component (modal, dropdown), wrap it in `wire:ignore.self` to keep its state.
livewire.php: To fire a toast or open a modal from PHP, dispatch an event from the component:
livewire.listen: And listen for it in your JavaScript with `Livewire.on()` inside `livewire:init`:
livewire.alpine: Or with Alpine, without writing separate JS:

messages.title: Texts and language
messages.desc: The texts your users see (search empty state, toast close button, table status and pagination, copy button) come in English. Change them site-wide with `setMessages()` or when initializing:
messages.attrs: Or for a single element, with attributes. The attribute wins over the global text:
messages.keys: Available keys. The `{name}` placeholders are replaced by the corresponding value:
messages.cdn: With the CDN script, add `data-cb-manual` and call `cobalto.setMessages()` before `cobalto.init()`.

fuente.title: Font
fuente.desc: Cobalto doesn't load any font on its own. If you add nothing, it uses the system monospace font. For JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts:
fuente.self: To self-host it (no requests to Google), install `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono` or declare your own `@font-face`, and if you want another family change the token:

paquete.title: What the package includes
uses: CSS source to import after Tailwind.
Only tokens, themes and the `dark:`/`light:` variants.

personalizacion.title: Customization
personalizacion.description: Change Cobalto's colors: one variable, a preset theme or your own theme. Includes a live customizer.
personalizacion.keywords: colors theme accent dark light tokens variables customizer
personalizacion.lead: All colors go through CSS variables. Change one and the whole library is recolored, without touching the components.

customizer.title: Live customizer
customizer.desc: Pick a color and watch this page change. The CSS below is ready to paste into your project. Colors adjust themselves to keep AA contrast in both modes.
customizer.tintHint: Backgrounds and borders pick up a bit of the accent.
customizer.previewText: The components across the page use the new color.

levels.title: Three levels
levels.one: **1. One variable.** Change `--cb-accent` and the 50–950 scale, the button fill, the soft backgrounds and the focus ring are recalculated.
levels.two: **2. A preset theme.** Six themes, each with its light and dark version.
levels.three: **3. Your own theme.** Define the values for each mode with the `--cb-dark-*` and `--cb-light-*` prefixes. See the full example in [Create your own theme](#tema-propio).

themes.title: Preset themes
themes.desc: Click to apply it to this page. Your choice is saved in `localStorage`. The color dots use nested `data-cb-accent`: a theme can also be applied to just one part of the page.

mode.title: Light and dark
mode.desc: Without an attribute, Cobalto follows `prefers-color-scheme` (dark if the system doesn't specify). `data-cb-theme` fixes it, on `html` or on any section.
mode.variants: Tailwind's `dark:` and `light:` variants follow the same rules:

scale.title: Accent scale
scale.desc: Generated with `color-mix(in oklab)` from `--cb-accent`. Available as variables (`--cb-accent-500`) and utilities (`bg-cb-accent-200`).

tokens.title: Color tokens
tokens.desc: Each token exists as a `--cb-*` variable and as a Tailwind utility: `bg-cb-bg-2`, `text-cb-muted`, `border-cb-line`, `bg-cb-accent/20`...

custom.title: Create your own theme
custom.desc: Copy this block, change the values and activate it with `data-cb-accent="marca"`. If you omit a token, Cobalto's is used. Make sure the text has at least 4.5:1 contrast against the background.
custom.status: Status colors can also be changed per mode: `--cb-dark-success`, `--cb-light-danger`, etc.

other.title: Other tokens
other.desc: Defined in `@theme`, so they also generate utilities (`font-cb-mono`, `rounded-cb-lg`, `py-cb-section`, `text-cb-4xl`...).

where.title: Where this CSS goes
where.desc: It's plain CSS, so it works the same in Laravel, Vite, TypeScript or an HTML file with no build. Paste it in your own stylesheet, after importing Cobalto. In Laravel that's `resources/css/app.css`:
where.cdn: With no build, put it in a file or in a `<style>` that loads after Cobalto's CSS:
where.warn: A `:root` block always wins, even over `data-cb-accent`: while it's there, the preset themes won't change the color. If you want your theme and also the ability to switch between themes, give it a name:
where.activate: And activate it in the HTML, or from JS when the user picks it. It is saved the same way as the preset themes:

topbar.title: Announcement bar
topbar.description: Top strip for statuses, short notices or contact information. It goes before the navbar.

con-estado.title: With status
con-estado.description: The `cb-dot` dot pulses with the accent color. Use `cb-dot--static` to remove the animation.

classes: Container with a bottom border and small text.
Centered row with the container's maximum width.
Main text with room for the dot.
a11y: Mark the dot with `aria-hidden="true"`: the text already conveys the status.
The dot animation stops with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

navbar.title: Navbar
navbar.description: Fixed bar with logo, menu with submenus (hover and click), search, theme toggle and call to action.

completa.title: Full
completa.description: Submenus use the same component as the dropdown. With `data-cb-dropdown-hover` they also open on mouse hover on devices that support it.

classes: Fixed top bar with a translucent background and blur.
Row with the container's maximum width and 64px height.
Logo with a square mark in the accent color.
Menu item and its link or button. `aria-current="page"` marks it as active.
Arrow that rotates when the submenu is open.
Group of actions aligned to the right.
Mobile menu button, visible only below 960px.
Search button with a keyboard shortcut.
Icons that swap automatically depending on the mode.
attributes: Opens the submenu on hover on devices with a mouse.
Switches between light and dark and saves the choice.
Shows ⌘K on Mac and Ctrl K elsewhere.
events: On the submenu's `li` when it opens or closes.
On `document` when the mode changes. `detail.theme` and `detail.resolved`.
a11y: Submenus are buttons with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; Esc closes them and returns focus.
Down arrow on the button opens the submenu and focuses the first link.
The theme button needs an `aria-label`; icons use `aria-hidden`.

menu-movil.title: Mobile menu
menu-movil.description: Full-screen menu that slides in from the right below the navbar. It closes when a link is chosen, with Esc, or when switching to desktop.

boton-y-panel.title: Button and panel
boton-y-panel.description: The button points to the panel's id with `data-cb-mobile-toggle`. Shrink the window below 960px to see it work.

classes: Fixed panel below the navbar. `.is-open` shows it.
Large link with a bottom border.
Number or arrow on the right of the link.
attributes: Button that opens and closes the panel.
events: On the panel. `cb:open` can be canceled.
a11y: The button automatically gets `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
When closed it has `visibility: hidden`, so its links don't receive focus.
Esc closes the menu and returns focus to the button.

hero.title: Hero
hero.description: Cover section with numbered label, large headline, text, actions, note and chips. The background grid is optional.
classes: Adds the background grid with a radial mask.
Headline with `clamp(40px, 7.4vw, 92px)` and -0.06em tracking. `em` dims it.
Row of buttons. On mobile they take the full width.
Top margin for the row of chips.
Utility: the grid on any container. Size set with `--cb-grid-size`.
a11y: Use a single `h1` per page.
The grid is a decorative pseudo-element with no content.

section-header.title: Section header
section-header.description: Numbered label, h2 title and paragraph. It's the piece that gives each section its editorial rhythm.

seccion-completa.title: Full section
seccion-completa.description: `cb-section` provides 110px of vertical padding (80px on mobile) and the bottom line.

classes: Section with vertical padding and a bottom border. `--flush` removes the border.
Container utility: `--cb-max` width and 24px gutter (16px on mobile).
Centers the block and the paragraph.
Uppercase label. `b` uses the accent color; the line is removed with `--plain`.
a11y: Keep the heading order: h1 in the hero, h2 per section, h3 inside each section.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Footer with link columns, giant decorative text and a bottom row.
classes: Title and list of each column.
a11y: The giant text is decorative: use `aria-hidden="true"`.
If the site has several `nav` elements, give each one a distinct `aria-label`.

sidebar-docs.title: Documentation sidebar
sidebar-docs.description: Side navigation with groups, active link, version selector and a table of contents that follows the scroll.

tabla-de-contenidos.title: Table of contents
tabla-de-contenidos.description: With `data-cb-scrollspy` the link of the visible section is marked automatically. It's the right column on this page.

classes: Column of groups. `--sticky` pins it while scrolling.
Link with a left line; `aria-current="page"` marks it.
Small badge in the accent color.
attributes: Marks the link whose section is on screen.
When the `select` changes, it navigates to the URL in its `value`.
events: On the `nav` with scrollspy when the active section changes (`detail.id`).
a11y: The current page uses `aria-current="page"`; the active section uses `aria-current="true"`.
The version `select` needs a label, even if it's `cb-sr-only`.

dashboard.title: Dashboard layout
dashboard.description: Fixed sidebar, topbar and content area. On mobile the sidebar becomes a side panel.
classes: Sidebar + content grid. The width is changed with `--cb-dash-sidebar`.
Fixed column. Below 960px it is an off-screen panel.
Dark backdrop behind the sidebar on mobile.
Link with an icon; `aria-current="page"` marks the accent line.
Fixed top bar of the content.
attributes: Button that opens it on mobile.
Backdrop that closes it on click.
events: On the sidebar when it opens or closes on mobile.
a11y: On mobile the sidebar traps focus and closes with Esc.
Use `main` for the content and `aria-label` on the sidebar.

card.title: Card
card.description: Flat card with a visual, status label, text, meta and an arrow that appears on hover.

con-visual.title: With visual
con-visual.description: If the card is a link, the `cb-card__go` arrow replaces the label on mouse hover.

visuales-decorativos.title: Decorative visuals
visuales-decorativos.description: Six ready-made mini visuals: `rows`, `bars`, `shop`, `phone`, `term` and `nodes`. All of them use the color tokens.

classes: Card with a 1px border, no shadow. If it is an `a` or `button`, the background changes on hover.
Enables hover on a card that is not a link.
Top row with number and label.
↗ arrow that appears on hover and focus.
Labels at the bottom, pushed to the end.
Decorative visuals. In `bars`, `i.is-accent` highlights a bar.
a11y: When the whole card is a link, the link text is all of its content: keep the title short and clear.
The visuals are decorative; they don't need alternative text.

grid.title: Card grid
grid.description: Grid with shared borders: the container draws the top and left, and each cell draws the right and bottom.

tres-columnas.title: Three columns
tres-columnas.description: Switches to two columns below 960px and to one below 600px.

classes: Three columns with shared borders and a 56px top margin.
a11y: If the cards form a list, you can use a `ul` with the `cb-grid` class and `li` as cells.

principios.title: Principles list
principios.description: Numbered list in three columns with a top line. Useful for values, features or steps.
classes: List in a 3-column grid (2 and 1 on small screens).
a11y: Use `ol` so the order is also announced by screen readers.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Large figures with a label, in a box with 1px dividers.
classes: 4-column box (2 below 960px). The inner lines don't depend on the number of cells.
a11y: Don't rely on color alone for the change: include the sign or text.

cta.title: CTA
cta.description: Centered call-to-action block to close a page.
classes: Centers the text, the `cb-lead` and the `cb-actions` it contains.
a11y: Link text should say where it leads, not just "click here".

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Price cards with a featured plan, feature list and a toggle between monthly and yearly billing.

tres-planes.title: Three plans
tres-planes.description: The `data-cb-billing` buttons change the prices marked with `data-cb-price-monthly` and `data-cb-price-yearly`.

classes: Grid of 3 plans with shared borders. `--2` and `--4` for other counts.
Plan. `--featured` adds a background and an accent top line.
attributes: Container that groups the selector and prices.
Element visible only in that period.
events: On the container when the period changes (`detail.period`).
a11y: The selector is a group of buttons with `aria-pressed`.
Disabled features shouldn't be conveyed by strikethrough alone; use clear text.

testimonios.title: Testimonials
testimonios.description: Quotes with author, role and avatar. Combine them with `cb-grid` to show several.
a11y: `figure` + `blockquote` + `figcaption` tie the quote to its author.

timeline.title: Timeline and changelog
timeline.description: Timeline with the date on the left. On mobile the date sits above each entry.
classes: Entry with a dot and a line. `.is-current` highlights the dot.
Title and details. Inner lists use dashes.
a11y: Use `time datetime="..."` so the date is machine-readable.

empty-state.title: Empty state
empty-state.description: Empty state with icon, text and actions for when a list or search has no results.
classes: Box with a dotted border and centered content.
a11y: If the empty state appears after filtering, announce it with an `aria-live` region.

codigo.title: Code block
codigo.description: Code with a header, a copy button and syntax colors that follow the theme.

copiar-un-texto.title: Copy a text
copiar-un-texto.description: With a value, `data-cb-copy` copies that text or the element with that id.

classes: Header with file name and button.
Copy button. `.is-copied` turns it green. `--floating` places it over the code.
attributes: With no value it copies the block's `pre`; with an id or selector it copies that element; with any other text, that text.
Alternative text for the copied state.
Text shown if copying failed. Default: "Copy failed".
a11y: The button changes its text to "Copied", which screen readers announce while it has focus.
Without HTTPS it falls back to an alternative copy method.

botones.title: Buttons
botones.description: Four main variants, three sizes, icons, and disabled and loading states.

deshabilitado-y-cargando.title: Disabled and loading
deshabilitado-y-cargando.description: For a disabled link use `aria-disabled="true"`. The loading state keeps the width and shows a spinner; use `aria-busy="true"` or the `is-loading` class.

grupo-de-acciones.title: Action group
grupo-de-acciones.description: `cb-actions` spaces the buttons apart and stretches them to full width on mobile.

classes: Thin border (the "ghost" of the original design).
No border, background only on hover.
a11y: Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.
Use `button` for actions and `a` for navigation.
`aria-busy="true"` signals that the action is in progress.
The visible focus ring uses the accent color with a 2px outline.

chips-tags.title: Chips and tags
chips-tags.description: Chips with a color swatch for filters or technologies, status tags and the `kbd` key.

chips.title: Chips
chips.description: The swatch color comes from `--cb-chip-color`; it defaults to the accent.

a11y: If a chip filters content, make it a `button` with `aria-pressed`.
Tag variants have AA contrast in every theme.

badge-avatar.title: Badge and avatar
badge-avatar.description: Counters, status dots and avatars with initials or an image, alone or in a group.
a11y: A status dot without text needs `role="img"` and `aria-label`.
If the avatar is an image, its `alt` should be the person's name.

dropdown.title: Dropdown
dropdown.description: Generic dropdown menu with keyboard navigation, shortcuts, dividers and destructive actions.

menu-de-acciones.title: Actions menu
menu-de-acciones.description: With `role="menu"` on the panel, the arrow keys move through the items and Home/End jump to the start and end.

classes: Floating panel. `--end` aligns it to the right, `--up` opens it upward, `--wide` widens it.
Item. `--rich` for number + title + description; `--danger` for destructive actions.
attributes: Button that opens it (by default, the first `button`).
Any element inside the panel that should close it.
events: On open or close. `cb:open` can be canceled.
a11y: The button gets `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-haspopup="menu"`.
Esc closes it and returns focus to the button; clicking outside also closes it.
Use `role="menu"` only for actions. For navigation links, leave the panel without a role.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
classes: Item; the "/" separator is added automatically.
a11y: Wrap it in `nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"`.
Mark the current page with `aria-current="page"`.

paginacion.title: Pagination
paginacion.description: Page buttons with previous, next and ellipsis.
classes: Text that is hidden on mobile.
a11y: Wrap it in `nav aria-label="Pagination"`.
The arrows need `aria-label` when the text is hidden.

formularios.title: Forms
formularios.description: Input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, switch and file, with help text and error and success states.

error-y-exito.title: Error and success
error-y-exito.description: The error state is enabled with `aria-invalid="true"` on the input or with `cb-field--error`. The message only shows in the error or success state.

classes: Groups label, control, hint and message.
Message visible only on error or success.
States. The error is also enabled with `aria-invalid="true"`.
Input, select or textarea. `--sm` and `--lg` for sizes.
Wrapper for the `select` with its own arrow.
Clickable label for checkbox, radio and switch.
a11y: Every control needs an associated `label` or `aria-label`.
Link hints and errors with `aria-describedby`.
The switch is a checkbox with `role="switch"`: it works with the keyboard without JS.
Color is not the only error signal: the message explains it in text.

tabla.title: Data table
tabla.description: Table with column sorting, search, filter, pagination and row selection. Without JS it looks like a normal table.

completa.title: Full
completa.description: Try sorting by amount or date, searching, filtering by status and selecting rows.

simple.title: Simple
simple.description: Without `data-cb-table` it is style only. `cb-table--compact` reduces the padding.

classes: Top bar with search and filters.
Highlighted cell, numeric cell (right aligned) and selection cell.
Sort button that JS creates inside the `th`.
attributes: Rows per page. Without it there is no pagination.
On a `th`, makes that column sortable.
On a cell, value used for sorting instead of the text.
Input that searches all columns (ignores accents).
Select that compares its value with the `data-clave` of each row.
Where to write the status and the pagination.
Text shown when there are no results. Default: "No results".
a11y: Sortable headers get `aria-sort` and a button so they can be used with the keyboard.
Selected rows carry `aria-selected="true"`.
The status ("Showing 1–5 of 8") lives in an `aria-live` region.
Each row checkbox needs an `aria-label` with the record's name.

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: Centered dialog with trapped focus, closing with Esc, backdrop click and `data-cb-close` buttons.

tamanos-y-estatico.title: Sizes and static
tamanos-y-estatico.description: With `data-cb-static`, clicking the backdrop does not close it. `cb-modal--center` centers it vertically.

attributes: On any button, opens that modal or drawer.
Changes the role for critical confirmations.
events: Before opening. Can be canceled with `preventDefault()`.
Before closing. It can also be canceled.
a11y: The panel gets `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to the title.
Focus moves to the first control (or the one with `autofocus`), stays trapped and returns to the button on close.
Esc closes only the topmost overlay when several are open.
Body scroll is locked while it is open.
snippets: From Livewire 4: dispatch the event with `$this->dispatch('abrir-modal', id: 'confirmar')` and listen for it with `Livewire.on()`:

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: Side panel (right, left or bottom) with the same behavior as the modal.
classes: 420px panel (at most the screen width minus 48px).
events: Before opening or closing; both can be canceled.
a11y: Same behavior as the modal: dialog role, trapped focus, Esc and focus return.

command-palette.title: Command palette
command-palette.description: ⌘K search with groups, arrow key navigation and accent-insensitive matching. It is the same one this documentation uses.

paleta.title: Palette
paleta.description: Results are read from a `script type="application/json"` inside the palette.

classes: List, group titles and results (`.is-active` is the selected one).
Hint, empty state and footer with shortcuts.
attributes: Shortcut with ⌘ or Ctrl. Without a value it uses K.
Text shown before the query when there are no results. Default: "No results for".
events: When a result is chosen (`detail.item`). Cancelable so you can handle navigation yourself.
a11y: The input is a `combobox` with `aria-activedescendant` pointing to the active result.
Results form a `listbox` with `aria-selected` options.
Focus is trapped inside the palette; Esc closes it and returns focus.
snippets: Load results from JS (for example, from an API):

tooltip-popover.title: Tooltip and popover
tooltip-popover.description: Text tooltip on hover and focus, and popover with interactive content that opens on click.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Use `data-cb-tooltip-placement` to choose the side; if it does not fit, it flips automatically.

classes: Text bubble that the JS creates in the `body`.
Container and panel. `--end` aligns to the right.
attributes: Button that opens it (by default, the first `button`).
events: On the popover when it opens or closes.
a11y: The tooltip is linked with `aria-describedby` while visible and closes with Esc (WCAG 1.4.13).
Do not put essential information only in a tooltip: it is not visible on touch screens.
The popover panel has `role="dialog"` and the button has `aria-expanded`.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Tabs with arrow, Home and End key navigation. Two styles: line and pills.
classes: Container. `--pills` switches to the pill style.
Row of tabs with horizontal scroll if they do not fit.
Panel; matched to the tab by order.
attributes: Arrows only move focus; Enter or Space activate.
a11y: The JS adds `role="tablist|tab|tabpanel"`, `aria-controls` and `aria-labelledby`.
Only the active tab is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Disabled tabs are skipped when navigating with arrows.

accordion.title: Accordion / FAQ
accordion.description: Based on `details` and `summary`: works without JS. The JS adds single-open mode and events.
classes: Each `details`. Height is animated in browsers that support `::details-content`.
attributes: Opening one closes the others. Without a value, all are independent.
events: On each `details` when it opens or closes.
a11y: `details`/`summary` are already accessible with keyboard and screen readers.
The icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`); the browser announces the state.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Temporary notifications with the `cobalto.toast()` API. They pause on hover or focus.

variantes.title: Variants
variantes.description: The buttons use `data-cb-toast` with the configuration as JSON, so you can try it without writing JS.

classes: Fixed container. `--top` and `--left` for other corners.
Notification with a colored side line.
attributes: On a button: JSON with the options or plain text.
events: On the toast when it appears and when it closes.
a11y: Toasts use `role="status"`; error toasts use `role="alert"` so they are announced immediately.
The timer pauses on hover and focus, to give time to read or use the action.
For important messages use `duration: 0` and let the user close it.
The close button uses "Close notification"; change it with the `closeLabel` option or with `cobalto.setMessages({ toastClose })`.
snippets: From Livewire 4, with an event dispatched using `$this->dispatch()`:

alert.title: Alert and banner
alert.description: Inline messages with four tones and full-width banners. They can be dismissed and remembered.
classes: Alert with a border and background in the tone color.
Full-width strip in the accent color. `--subtle` makes it neutral.
attributes: Button that closes the alert or banner that contains it.
events: On the container before hiding it; cancelable.
a11y: Use `role="alert"` only for urgent errors; for the rest, `role="status"`.
The close button needs `aria-label`.

progress.title: Progress bar
progress.description: Determinate or indeterminate progress bar, with label and value.
classes: Track and bar. The width comes from `--cb-progress`.
a11y: The track has `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`.
In indeterminate mode, omit `aria-valuenow`.

skeleton-spinner.title: Skeleton and spinner
skeleton-spinner.description: Loading placeholders and a spinner that takes the text or accent color.
classes: Stacked text lines; the last one is shorter.
a11y: Mark the loading container with `aria-busy="true"`.
A spinner only needs `role="status"` and `aria-label`.
Animations stop with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: Steps of a process, horizontal or vertical. On mobile the horizontal one stacks.
classes: List of steps. `--vertical` for the vertical version.
Step. `.is-complete` marks it as done; `aria-current="step"` is the current one.
a11y: Use `ol` and `aria-current="step"` on the current step.
If the completed marker is "✓", add hidden text such as "completed" in `cb-sr-only`.
